description: This file defines the CognitoIdentityClient class used to interact with Amazon Cognito Identity service, including method signatures for various operations and their asynchronous counterparts.

classes.name: CognitoIdentityClient
classes.description: Client class for Amazon Cognito Identity service, extending AwsClient with methods for identity management.

methods.name: getCredentialsForIdentity
methods.description: Gets credentials for a specific identity.

methods.name: getIdentityPoolRoles
methods.description: Gets roles associated with an identity pool.

methods.name: getOpenIdTokenForDeveloperIdentity
methods.description: Gets an OpenID token for a developer identity.

methods.name: getPrincipalTagAttributeMap
methods.description: Retrieves the principal tag attribute map.

methods.name: setIdentityPoolRoles
methods.description: Sets roles for an identity pool.

methods.name: setPrincipalTagAttributeMap
methods.description: Sets the principal tag attribute map.
